## Purpose

Describe the change and link any related issue.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Tests or maintenance

## Validation

- [ ] `npm ci`
- [ ] `npm test -- --watch=false`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Relevant documentation and tests updated
- [ ] No secrets, environment files, installed dependencies, caches, or build output included

For UI or routing changes, describe browser checks of the counter, direct deep
links, refreshes, and unknown routes. Distinguish local checks from live
Builder deployment results.

## Breaking changes

Describe any changed routes, build paths, or deployment behavior.
